title: Search Operators
body:
Does InstantSearch support search operators such as AND and OR? 

I found it in the docs, but doesn't seem to work for InstantSearch:
https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/searching/filtering/#boolean-operators

comments.body: Hey @Brotakuu, can you show what you've tried already? Search operators should work

AND and OR operators in search box. I didn't find a setting to enable them in the dashboard. 

For example: I tried a search such as "apple OR oranges" directly into the algolia dashboard search box under the "Browse" tab, and the operators are not enabled.

I’m not sure if this is what you mean, but try putting “advancedSyntax: true” in searchParameters on the constructor. See also: https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/api-parameters/advancedSyntax/
@Brotakuu have you been able to work something out?
I'll close this issue since there was no response. Feel free to continue commenting or open a new issue if there's more questions though!
